title: Parent / Guardian
format: Actual application screen captures with fictional isolated demo records; no live authentication, native installation or reconnect sync verification
voice: User-selected English voice-02; not a verified Nigerian-English accent

scenes.label: School link & parent sign-in
scenes.narration: Open your school's branded link. Staff and parents use their registered phone and four-digit PIN. This recording uses fictional demo records and a local session, not live authentication.

scenes.label: Linked children & attendance
scenes.narration: The Parent Portal shows only your linked children. Select a sibling and review the chosen term and attendance. These demo children are fictional; another family is excluded from this view.

scenes.label: Published result → A4 report
scenes.narration: Select Print Report Card for a published result. Inspect the actual fixed A four page before printing or saving to PDF. Parents do not enter scores or see unpublished results.

scenes.label: Fees, receipts & transfer safety
scenes.narration: Scroll to the child fee summary and official receipts. Inspect the demo receipt. Confirm payment instructions with the school; a transfer notice is not proof that money was received.

scenes.label: Install your school app
scenes.narration: Open your school's link and choose Install school app. The real help dialog explains Safari and Chrome steps. A native installation is not being verified here.

scenes.label: Safe offline viewing
scenes.narration: Sign in online first and open the records you need on your own device. Offline copies may be out of date until reconnection. New sign-ins, payments and messages need internet. Keep your PIN private; live sync is not being verified here.

timingBasis: Detected paragraph-pause cuts, reviewed against expected text length; captions phrase-timed within each recorded scene.
